blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY, ALBAY, Philippines — Two whale sharks were spotted in the waters off Calabanga, Camarines Sur, on Thursday afternoon, drawing the attention of residents as the marine animals swam just meters from the shoreline. Paul Christian Santos, village chief of Barangay Baybay, said in a phone interview that residents noticed the whale sharks when their fins surfaced above the water. Numerous birds were also seen flying over the animals. Santos said the whale sharks remained in the area for several hours before disappearing before nightfall.
